front: Duck behind an obstacle to improve cover: standard cover becomes greater, or you gain standard cover.
back:
Standard cover becomes greater cover: +4 circumstance bonus to AC, Reflex saves vs. area effects, and Stealth to Hide, Sneak, or avoid detection. Otherwise you gain standard cover (+2).
If prone, you gain greater cover against ranged attacks.
Lasts until you move, attack, fall unconscious, or end it as a free action.
